facts.statement: Kela is both the responsible organisation and the producer of the housing benefits service.
The housing benefits service provided by Kela is free of charge and publicly funded.
Kela's housing assistance is targeted at low-income households.
facts.quote: Kela provides assistance with housing for low-income households by paying housing allowances.

facts.statement: Kela supports housing by paying housing allowances.
facts.quote: Kela tukee pienituloisten asumista maksamalla asumistukea.

facts.statement: Most Kela benefits are generally available on application only.
facts.quote: Most benefits provided by Kela are generally available on application only.

facts.statement: Reimbursements of medical, pharmaceutical and travel expenses are paid as direct on-the-spot reimbursements without an application.
facts.quote: However, reimbursements of medical, pharmaceutical and travel expenses are available as direct on-the-spot reimbursements, with no application required.

facts.statement: The citizen can apply for most benefits online using Kela's OmaKela e-service.
facts.quote: You can apply for most benefits, submit documents supporting your application and report changes online using Kela’s OmaKela e-service.

facts.statement: The citizen can submit documents supporting the application (attachments) online via OmaKela.
The citizen can report changes to Kela online via OmaKela.
The citizen can check the status of their application in OmaKela.
facts.quote: You can also check the status of your application and payment dates.

facts.statement: Payment dates of the benefit are viewable by the citizen in OmaKela.
facts.quote: tarkistaa hakemuksesi tilanteen ja tuen maksupäivät

facts.statement: Citizens needing help can call Kela's customer service (telephone service).
facts.quote: If you need help, you can call Kela’s customer service number or visit a Kela service point.

facts.statement: Citizens needing advice can visit a Kela service point.
facts.quote: Jos tarvitset neuvoja, soita Kelan puhelinpalveluun tai tule käymään palvelupisteessä.

facts.statement: General housing allowance is one of Kela's housing benefits.
Housing allowance for pensioners is one of Kela's housing benefits.
Housing assistance for conscripts (part of conscript's allowance) is one of Kela's housing benefits.
No requirements are listed in the service record.
No legislation is listed in the service record.
The service is linked to the life events conscription, retirement and beginning full-time studies, and targets citizens.
facts.quote: [Life events] Conscription; Retirement; Beginning full-time studies

facts.statement: The service has 232 service channels in total, of which 73 are office/service point channels.
There are 73 office/service point channels for the service.
Service channels include OmaKela and Kela's telephone service for personal customers.
Service channels include municipal joint service/customer service points (asiointipiste), libraries and municipal offices offering Kela services.
